headline: US jury convicts China tech giant Huawei of stealing trade secrets
summary: A US jury convicted Chinese telecom equipment maker Huawei of stealing trade secrets but acquitted it of a more serious racketeering charge. The Trump administration has targeted Huawei over alleged spying for Beijing.
why: Huawei is a major global telecom equipment manufacturer, and US restrictions on it affect supply chains and 5G infrastructure markets. Legal outcomes can influence trade and technology policy.
